title: Prescribed standard simplicial resolution data of a comonad
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an ordinary category and let $(T,e,c)$ be a comonad: an endofunctor $T:\mathcal C\to\mathcal C$ with natural transformations $e:T\to\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $c:T\to T^2$ satisfying $(eT)c=1_T=(Te)c$ and $(cT)c=(Tc)c$. Define its powers by $T^0=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C}$ and $T^{n+1}=T\circ T^n$. For a simplicial object $B_\bullet$ in endofunctors [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-object] and an augmentation $a:B_\bullet\to\operatorname{const}(\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal C})$, say that $(B_\bullet,a)$ is a standard simplicial resolution of $(T,e,c)$ if $B_n=T^{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$, its faces are $d_i=T^i e T^{n-i}:B_n\to B_{n-1}$ for $n\geq1$, $0\leq i\leq n$, its degeneracies are $s_i=T^i c T^{n-i}:B_n\to B_{n+1}$ for $n\geq0$, $0\leq i\leq n$, and $a_0=e$. The operator equalities use transport along the specified equalities of their source and target functors. This defines a predicate on the supplied augmented simplicial object, without asserting its existence.
